purpose: Finish the already sealed 330-cell multi-sample schedule after a verified 76-cell prefix. No new human judgment is collected and no paid API is used.
predecessor_manifest_serialization: sorted UTF-8 lines: relative_path, tab, decimal_bytes, tab, lowercase_sha256, newline
failure_policy: The five historical rejected attempts and the nine sequence-77 failure artifacts are immutable lineage only. None may be copied or promoted as accepted evidence.

provider.fresh_session_policy: Every new provider session ID must be distinct from the 146 predecessor IDs and all other successor IDs.

normalization.rule: Use a raw evidence quote unchanged when it is an exact source substring. Otherwise remove exactly one matching outer curly-quote pair only when the interior is an exact source substring. No trimming, fuzzy matching, inner edits, or other normalization is allowed.
normalization.raw_response_policy: Keep raw response and raw result bytes beside the deterministic projection and audit.

remote_disclosure: Each new dispatch uses the v1 Codex route and sends only the already-disclosed source and originating prompt. The operator reviews this before starting; dry-run makes zero provider calls.
